**Finding submitted — AUDIT: deviation (fallback target).**

- **Responsive locations inspected:** §9.8 (p0167, the only audit right binding us as audited Party), §9.9 (p0168, F&ASC procedures), §9.4 (p0163) and §4.7 (p0123) (rights against the Supplier), §10.8 (p0177, inspection at the inspecting Party's own expense — a right in our favour, not flagged).
- **Failure:** §9.8 permits any Party to review or audit our cost books with no frequency cap and no notice — unlimited/unannounced, i.e. walk-away territory. §9.9's reference to the F&ASC's audit procedures is extrinsic and supplies neither limit.
- **Already met:** cost allocation — the audited Party recovers its entire reasonable compliance costs from the requesting Party, with no underpayment threshold, which exceeds the fallback; left verbatim.
- **Edit:** one surgical in-sentence insertion adding "no more than once per year and on 15 days' notice", preserving all other wording and the retained cost-recovery mechanics (validated ok:true, minimality passed).
